cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Name Your Backers
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal who supports their position, who authorized it, and who benefits from it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've circled the cheap roof tile like you did. We're both recommending it, then. Who else backed this choice?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I circled it to mark the cracked sample. Finance wants those tiles; I need your signature to order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, noting the sample. Who authorized Finance to choose them?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The facilities director. The savings pay for her office refurbishment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put her name and that refurbishment beside the saving. Before I sign, she can explain it to the maintenance team.

reason: Copy a defect mark as recommendation, then use discovered funding beneficiary to demand explicit accountable backing.
